parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The restraint rule is unambiguous: any cluster where a participating record is a test fixture must be recommended as no-action. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.818 suggests structural overlap between `ReviewRequestServiceTests.shouldRequestReviewAtThreshold` (line 90) and `ReviewRequestServiceTests.actionsAfterReviewDoNotRetrigger` (line 177), these are distinct test scenarios for the `ReviewRequestService` — one verifying threshold-triggered review requests and the other verifying that post-review actions do not re-trigger the prompt. Collapsing them into a generic helper would obscure test intent and couple unrelated assertions. No production code is involved, so there is no cross-boundary duplication to address.
